title: A rename made in the code with a refactoring tool
prompt: I renamed Buyer to Customer in the code with a refactoring tool. Bring the model up to date.
done: the model calls the class Customer and the code still has the developer's rename

expect.text: The Domain designer has a Customer class and no Buyer class.
Customer is the original Buyer element renamed in place, not a new element: it keeps Buyer's attributes, operations and associations (to Order and PaymentMethod).

Everything in the model that referenced Buyer still references Customer: the repository's entity, the domain event's property, the Order association, and the Services designer's entity actions on it (ValidateOrAddBuyerAggregateWhenOrderStartedDomainEventHandler's create action and its update action on VerifyOrAddPaymentMethod).
The model still maps Customer to the table buyers.
The code has no Buyer class again: a Software Factory proposal to recreate Buyer.cs was declined or never applied.
